headline.en: Lift Every Voice and Sing: hear the whole song first, then the tune on its own.
headline.es: Lift Every Voice and Sing: escucha primero la canción entera y luego la melodía sola.

detail.en: The whole song, every part together
detail.es: La canción entera, con todas las voces

detail.en: The guide sings it, line by line
detail.es: La guía la canta frase a frase

detail.en: Stop if anything tightens or hurts
detail.es: Si algo se tensa o duele, para

headline.en: Now the tune on its own.

detail.en: Follow the words as it plays

text.en: Find the notes of line 1: each one waits until you're on it.
text.es: Busca las notas de la frase 1: cada una te espera hasta que estés en ella.

text.en: James Weldon Johnson wrote the poem for a celebration of Abraham Lincoln's birthday in Jacksonville, Florida, in 1900, where a choir of 500 schoolchildren first sang it.
text.es: James Weldon Johnson escribió el poema para una celebración del cumpleaños de Abraham Lincoln en Jacksonville, Florida, en 1900, donde un coro de 500 escolares lo cantó por primera vez.

source.en: NAACP, "Lift Every Voice and Sing", History Explained; Chris Fenner, "Lift every voice and sing", Hymnology Archive (2019), quoting Johnson's own account; Cait Miller, Library of Congress In the Muse blog (8 February 2022)
source.es: NAACP, "Lift Every Voice and Sing", History Explained; Chris Fenner, "Lift every voice and sing", Hymnology Archive (2019), que cita el relato del propio Johnson; Cait Miller, Library of Congress In the Muse blog (8 de febrero de 2022)

text.es: Escucha la frase 1 y repítela.

text.en: The whole song, with the guide.
text.es: La canción entera, con la guía.

text.en: Sing your part with the other parts, and the guide with you. Hold your line while the others move.
text.es: Canta tu parte con las demás voces, y la guía contigo. Mantente firme en ella mientras las otras se mueven.

text.en: The guide drops out: your part with the others only. Give me my note plays your first note quietly.
text.es: La guía deja de cantar: tu parte, solo con las demás voces. "Escuchar mi nota" te da tu primera nota, suave.

text.en: Once more on your own, from the top.
text.es: Otra vez sin guía, desde el principio.

text.en: Record the tune of Lift Every Voice and Sing in Sing, with the other parts playing.
text.es: Graba la melodía de Lift Every Voice and Sing en Cantar, con las demás voces sonando.

text.en: By 1920 the NAACP was calling it the "Negro national anthem".
text.es: Ya en 1920 la NAACP lo llamaba el "Negro national anthem" ("himno nacional negro").

source.en: Cait Miller, "Lift Every Voice and Sing", Library of Congress In the Muse blog (2022); Burton W. Peretti, "Lift Ev'ry Voice and Sing", National Recording Registry essay, Library of Congress
source.es: Cait Miller, "Lift Every Voice and Sing", Library of Congress In the Muse blog (2022); Burton W. Peretti, "Lift Ev'ry Voice and Sing", ensayo del National Recording Registry, Library of Congress
